full_judgment:
2. Alleging commission of offence punishable under sections 406/420/467/468 and 471 of the Penal Code one Md Sajal Chowdhury, being an informant lodged Turag Police Station Case No. 8 dated 10-4-2010 corresponding to GR No. 42 of 2010 implicating the accused petitioners with the alleged occurrence alleging, inter alia, that the case property as described in the schedule belonged to one Laljan Bibi, Keti Bibi and Kanu Bibi whose names were duly recorded in CS Khatian No. 202 of CS Plot Nos. 2288 and 2313 respectively measuring 10.43 acres of land. While Kanu Bibi was owning and possessing the same SA Khatian was duly recorded in her name under SA Khatian No. 373. Subsequently, she died leaving behind 3 (three) daughters namely Fazar Bibi, Chandraban Bibi and Surjaban Bibi. While they were owning and possessing the same they sold out 2.4 acres of land to one Amin Box and Rokeya Khatun vide registered deed No. 5521 dated 24-4-1970. Later, said Rokeya Khatun sold out her portion of share to one Amin Box vide registered deed No. 3515 dated 7-7-1973. Said Amin Box while enjoying possession of his purchased land measuring 2.45 acres sold out 0.33 acres of land to one Abul Kashem vide deed No.36 dated 4-1-1978. Said Abul Kashem subsequently sold out the said land i.e., 0.33 acres to one Mrs Delwara Begum and others vide registered deed No. 1685 dated 1-3-1995 with possession thereof, who, however, in turn had appointed the informant of the present case as their respective attorney. 

 10. The accused petitioners as defendants contested the said suit by filing written statements denying all the material averment so made therein stating, inter alia, that in 1933-34 the properties of Baunia Mouza under CS Khatian No.202 comprising CS Plot Nos. 1520, 1521, 2288, 2302, 2313 measuring 15.19 acres were put into auction for arrear of rent under Certificate Case No.255DW/1933-34. One Khetro Mohan Barai and Rahman Box Bepari purchased the suit land and ultimately, the auction sale was confirmed in their .favour on 30-8-1934. Thus, the right, title and interest of Keti Bibi and others were extinguished. It has also been contended therein that one Falu Miah purchased 1.72 acres of land from one Khetro Mohan Barai on 28-1-1946 vide deed No.574 and Falu Miah and his brothers had purchased 3.15 acres of land on 24-8-1960 vide deed No. 10946. They, however, had purchased another 1.901/2 acres of land on 27-9-1960 vide deed No. 12307 from one Rahman Box Bepari with possession thereof. Accordingly, they had been paying rent to the authority concern. 

 11. In this regard, it has also been averred that some portion of land of Falu Miah and his brother was acquired by the government in LA Case No. 181/62-63 and accordingly, they were awarded compensation money. Subsequently, Falu Mia and his brothers' name were duly recorded in SA Khatian No. 373 appertaining to plot Nos. 2288 and 2313 corresponding to RS khatian No. 991, RS plot Nos. 6349,6350 with some other plots.
